    A small number of boxsets may contain an incorrect DISC FIVE. In some cases, this disc does not have the "Workprint" content but rather the content of "The Final Cut". To recognize the error, play disc five and go to the Special Features page: if you see one commentary track by Paul M. Sammon, the disc is correct, but if the menu shows three commentary tracks, then the disc is incorrect. To receive a replacement disc, call Warner Home Video at 1-800-553-6937 (US).

    OVERALL: Draw

    The US, Canadian, French, and UK "30th Anniversary" releases have an additional photo gallery in HD.
    Other changes/additions compared to the Complete Collector's Edition:
    - All the extras are now on Blu-ray discs (Though "Dangerous Days" is still in SD).
    - The Workprint version has DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1.

    For audio, the Japanese "The Final Cut" 4K + Blu-ray release has a Dolby Atmos track, but only includes the Final Cut version.

    Also note the former "Ultimate Collector's Edition" has some exclusive collectibles.

    OTHER COMPARISONS:
    Movie-Censorship have done a comparison between the 1982 International Cut and the 1992 Director's Cut HERE.
    They have also done a comparison between the 1992 Director's Cut and the 2007 Final Cut HERE.

    (Visitor Gavin Salkeld reports a branching error on The Director's Cut on Disc 3 (at 24:05). When the janitor opens the door to Leon's room, he mutters, "Kowalski". This is dialogue which only belongs in the Workprint and Final Cut versions and doesn't have subtitles either.)
